'''Meidericher Spielverein 02 e. V. Duisburg''', commonly known as simply '''MSV Duisburg''' ({{IPA|de|ʔɛm ʔɛs faʊ ˈdyːsbʊɐ̯k}}), is a [[Football in Germany|German association football club]] based in [[Duisburg]], [[North Rhine-Westphalia]]. Nicknamed ''Die Zebras'' for their traditional striped jerseys, the club was one of the original members of the [[Bundesliga]] when it was formed in 1963."}}
